name: 25105-longprefill-qwen3next80b-4gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bfloat16, 41 shards / 162.65 GB. Present in this machine's HF cache and complete: 152 GiB of blobs and all 50 snapshot entries resolve. An earlier purge left every shard symlink dangling; that is no longer the state, so check by resolving the symlinks rather than trusting either claim.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 (half an a3 node, --gres=gpu:4), NVLink, bare metal.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM hybrid decoder: 48 layers, `full_attention_interval: 4`, hidden 2048, 16 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256, vocab 151936, sparse MoE with 512 experts and 10 active per token plus a shared expert (~3B active of 80B total).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10% and cooldown 10%, bounded at 512 requests.
workload: `synthetic_text`, fixed shape: exactly 32768 prompt tokens and exactly 1 output token, min = max on both. Pure prefill by construction -- the single token is sampled at the end of the last prefill chunk, so no decode step runs. Seed 25105, static.
purpose: A document-analysis assistant for 80-billion-parameter long-context reports, handling eight concurrent 32k-token submissions across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Nothing here is tuned; there is no tuned.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4

# Written rather than left to default, and the defaults differ: this engine resolves
# max_num_batched_tokens to 8192 for an OpenAI API server on a >=70 GiB non-A100 device, but to
# 16384 when driven in-process. Unset, it would run a different operating point depending on how
# the engine is started.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-num-seqs: 16
max-model-len: 40960
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
